stem_book: The potential energy φ in joule of a particle of mass 1 kg moving in the x-y plane obeys the law φ = 3x + 4y. Here, x and y are in metres. If the particle is at rest at (6 m, 8 m) at time t = 0, then the work done by the conservative force on the particle from the initial position to the instant when it crosses the x-axis is (a) 25 J (b) −25 J (c) 50 J (d) −50 J
reason: 'at rest' added: the print gives no initial velocity, and the crossing point (hence the answer) depends on it.
work: F = −(3î + 4ĵ) along the line to the origin → crosses x-axis at (0,0): W = φ_i − φ_f = 50 − 0 = 50 J
